episodeMeans: All episodes, including partial/failure, have equal weight. pathLengthM sums succeeded geometry legs; do not divide by legs or retain only completed episodes.
pairedDifference: variant minus baseline within the exact same sceneId/seed and frozen input; relativeDelta is null when baseline is zero.
cluster: occupancyGeometryHash; average paired condition deltas inside each geometry, then give each geometry equal weight.

bootstrap.sampling: Geometry clusters with replacement, preserving all paired fault conditions and all metrics/arms together.
bootstrap.interval: Descriptive 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles, linearly interpolated at (replicates-1)*q.

communication: meanObservationJSONBytes is the arithmetic mean of episode.messageBytes over all episodes; the historical field name is retained for compatibility and is not limited to raw observations. Count all actual recorded communication channels, including observation_upload, occupancy_relay, coverage_delta (coverage IDs), coverage_reconnect_snapshot (coverage IDs), reconnect_snapshot (occupancy), and the legacy combined observation_upload_and_relay channel when present. Delayed maps count only when sent; unsent queued packets are not transmitted bytes. These are canonical JSON payload bytes, excluding network framing, TLS, task leases, controller traffic and other unmeasured transport overhead.
inputCommunicationDescription: Canonical observation payload upload plus relay and reconnect snapshot; excludes network framing, TLS and lease/control messages.
limitations: No multiple-comparison adjustment or significance decision.
Intervals describe this fixed study's empirical layouts; no universal optimality or population generalization claim.
Planning wall time depends on host load; this is not physical robot or network validation.
Configured seeds/paired task conditions are not necessarily independent physical maps; cluster normalization prevents duplicate geometry from increasing its weight.
